zh-CN.shortDescription: 用传输码连接设备，通过 IPv6 加密直传文件与文本。支持 SHA-256 校验、私有收件箱和可调限速。
zh-CN.description:
把文件和文本，直接传到另一台设备。

HermodTransfer 是一款使用 IPv6 的加密点对点传输工具。选择文件或输入文本，将传输码分享给接收方，即可建立连接。文件在双方设备之间传输，信令服务器负责协助连接。

传输完成后，HermodTransfer 使用 SHA-256 校验文件内容。接收文件保存在私有收件箱，你可以查看并另存到指定位置。即使导出失败，已验证的收件箱副本仍会保留，方便稍后重试。文本以文本文件的形式接收。

按你的网络情况调整传输限速，让上行带宽为其他应用留出余量。发送默认使用 WireGuard，接收自动跟随发送方；高级设置还支持 QUIC、MTU 和拥塞控制。你可以查看进度、复制传输码或随时取消当前任务。

桌面界面支持简体中文、英文、跟随系统语言，以及浅色和深色主题。Windows 版提供 x64 与 ARM64 架构，并可与使用兼容版本 HermodTransfer 的其他设备传输。

连接要求：双方设备都需要可达的 IPv6，并允许传输所需的 UDP 流量及信令连接。当前不支持 IPv4-only 网络、文件中转或断点续传。实际速度取决于双方带宽、网络路径和限速设置。传输期间请保持应用运行，并仅向接收方分享传输码。卸载应用前，请先导出收件箱中的重要文件。
features: 通过传输码连接，发送文件或文本
基于 IPv6 的加密点对点直传
SHA-256 完整性校验
私有收件箱，支持另存已验证副本
可调传输限速，兼顾其他网络应用
WireGuard 与 QUIC 两种传输协议
统一 MTU 和拥塞控制设置
查看传输进度并随时取消任务
信令服务器指纹校验与信任管理
简体中文与英文，支持系统语言和明暗主题
systemRequirements: Windows 10 版本 2004 或更新版本，或 Windows 11
x64 或 ARM64 处理器
发送与接收设备均具备可达的 IPv6
网络和防火墙允许对端 UDP 流量及信令服务器连接

en-US.shortDescription: Connect with a transfer code and send files or text directly over encrypted IPv6. Includes SHA-256 verification, a private inbox and adjustable bandwidth limits.
en-US.description:
Send files and text directly to another device.

HermodTransfer is an encrypted, peer-to-peer transfer app built for IPv6. Choose a file or enter a message, share the transfer code with your recipient, and connect. File data travels between the two devices; the signaling server helps them establish the connection.

HermodTransfer checks transferred content with SHA-256. Received files stay in a private inbox, ready to save to a location you choose. If an export fails, the verified inbox copy is retained so you can try again. Messages arrive as text files.

Adjust the transfer limit to leave upload capacity for other apps. Send with WireGuard by default and let the receiver follow the sender automatically. Advanced settings also offer QUIC, MTU and congestion control options. View progress, copy the transfer code and cancel the current task when needed.

The desktop interface supports English and Simplified Chinese, system language selection, and light or dark themes. Windows builds support x64 and ARM64 devices and can transfer with other devices running compatible versions of HermodTransfer.

Connection requirements: both devices need reachable IPv6, permission to exchange UDP traffic, and access to the signaling server. IPv4-only networks, file relays and transfer resumption are not supported. Actual speed depends on both connections, the network path and your bandwidth settings. Keep the app running during a transfer and share the code only with your recipient. Export important inbox files before uninstalling the app.
features: Connect with a transfer code to send files or text
Encrypted peer-to-peer transfers over IPv6
SHA-256 integrity verification
Private inbox with exportable verified copies
Adjustable bandwidth limits to leave room for other apps
WireGuard and QUIC transport options
Shared MTU and congestion control settings
Transfer progress and cancellation
Signaling server fingerprint verification and trust management
English and Simplified Chinese, system language, light and dark themes
systemRequirements: Windows 10 version 2004 or newer, or Windows 11
Reachable IPv6 on both the sending and receiving devices
Network and firewall rules allowing peer UDP traffic and signaling server access
en-US.updateNotes: Corrected the Windows Store display name to the reserved HermodTransfer name. Bundled x64 and ARM64 into a single MSIXBundle; the Store delivers the matching architecture. Supports English, Simplified Chinese and system language selection.
